title: Pivot-table UI redesign — full codebase survey complete
body: Surveyed all key UI files before generating options: app.tsx (3-tab shell), grid.tsx (582-line AG Grid), sidebar.tsx, store.ts, layout-card.tsx, pipeline-card.tsx, filter-sort-card.tsx, column-chips.tsx (native HTML5 DnD), run-bar.tsx, calc-stage.tsx, calc-builder.tsx, chip.tsx, modal.tsx, aggregation.ts, export.ts, filter-list.tsx, sort-list.tsx, types.ts (AppState/ReportSpec), style.css (792 lines). Key findings: existing DnD is HTML5 DragEvent-based, store uses pub/sub with deep clone, report execution is sync (setTimeout 20ms wrapper), lower layers (core→catalog→query→report) are untouched in this rewrite.
